builder.lineNext: Across the river deep and wide
stanza: I was a dam builder
Across the river deep and wide
Where steel and water did collide
A place called Boulder on the wild Colorado
I slipped and fell into the wet concrete below
They buried me in that great tomb that knows no sound
But I am still around

builder.lineNext: He swung his hammer brown and silver
stanza: Your daddy was a builder
He swung his hammer brown and silver
Every time he closed his eyes a nail was drove
And you were always underfoot
Like a splinter in the wood
He couldn't pull you from his heels

partner.line: He swung his hammer brown and silver

bewilder.lineNext: I know nothing stays the same
stanza: Baby sneezes
Mommy pleases
Daddy breezes in
So good on paper
So romantic but so bewildering

bewilder.linePrev: Won't you write me a letter? Won't you give me a call?
bewilder.lineNext: Bewildered, Bewildered, you have no complaint
stanza: Dear Abby, dear Abby, my feet are too long
My hair's falling out and my rights are all wrong
My friends they all tell me that I've no friends at all
Won't you write me a letter? Won't you give me a call?
Signed, Bewildered

bewilder.linePrev: And some, to see a bear, would pay a fee
bewilder.line: Me, I just bear up to my bewildered best
bewilder.lineNext: And some folks even see the bear in me
stanza: Some folks drive the bears out of the wilderness
And some, to see a bear, would pay a fee
Me, I just bear up to my bewildered best
And some folks even see the bear in me

bewilder.line: Bewildered, Bewildered, you have no complaint
bewilder.lineNext: You are what you are and you ain't what you ain't
stanza: Bewildered, Bewildered, you have no complaint
You are what you are and you ain't what you ain't
So listen up, buster, and listen up good
Stop wishing for bad luck and knocking on wood
